content_sections.heading: NMDC Apollo Central Hospital Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NMDC Apollo Central Hospital Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: NMDC Apollo Central Hospital is conducting a walk-in interview for various medical professional positions. This is a great opportunity for healthcare professionals to join a reputable organization.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which the recruitment is being done?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Medical Professionals, specifically including Nephrologist, Specialist (Medicine), Specialist (Gen. Surgery), Specialist (Radiology), and GDMO positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for these positions?
faq.answer: The application mode for these positions is a Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for these positions?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and the specific dates for the interviews are mentioned in the important dates section. Candidates should check these dates carefully.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for the GDMO post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the GDMO post is MBBS with a minimum of one year of experience after compulsory internship of one year.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the GDMO post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the GDMO post is 45 years. Age relaxation may be considered for specialist doctors and departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for a Nephrologist?
faq.answer: The salary range for a Nephrologist is Rs. 48.00 to 60.00 Lakhs per annum, depending on experience and qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be conducted at two locations: NMDC Office (GEC), Raipur, and Apollo Health City, Visakhapatnam. Candidates should check the specific dates for each venue.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original certificates, detailed bio-data, self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates regarding application fees.
